description:
50 miles long range and fat tire electric bike with 26" x 4" fat tires for adults.
Why Choose Rail 6 ？
The Rail 6 ebike seamlessly combines unparalleled performance with a classic design. It is equipped with a powerful 2000W peak motor and a 48V 20AH high-capacity built-in removable battery. It can reach a top speed of 28 MPH. In pedal-assist mode, it offers a range of up to 50 miles. It also features front fork suspension and rear shock absorption, effectively absorbing impacts during riding. Whether on flat roads or rugged mountain trails, it handles with ease, taking you wherever you want to go.
Faster, Stronger, & More Fierce than Ever
The Perfect Balance of Power and Speed.Build for Bold Moves, Ready for Every Mile.Powered by a 750W rated motor/2000W peak motor with 95Nm torque, ensuring smooth control and thrilling rides.
50 Miles of Range
A 960Wh semi-invisible battery powers up to 50 miles, perfect for daily commutes or extended adventures without range anxiety.
Full Suspension
26"X4" fat tires with lockable front suspension and rear shock absorbs more bumps. Let you enjoy a comfortable ride. Riders can adjust the switch and hardness according to the terrain. Easy to cope with all kinds of terrain.
Smart Display
Color smart display provides riding data. For example: real-time speed, battery level, PAS level, mileage and more. Display backlight brightness is adjustable. Easily track your ride and reach your cycling goals, day or night
Bright headlight, Singal and Taillight
Rail 6 equipped with bright headlight and taillight,provide you a safer and more enjoyable environment for nightriding,enjoy riding without time constraints.
